import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import re,json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();out=[]
for n in ['openai','leanpool','tauceti','deepmind']:
 t=Path('sources/registry-'+n+'.html').read_text();m=re.search(r'"currentOid":"([a-f0-9]+)"',t);head=m.group(1) if m else None
 print(n,head)
 out.append({'name':n,'currentOid':head,'scope':'repository root only; no theorem bodies or completeness claim'})
b=Path('sources/subgraph-centrality.pdf').read_bytes();print('CURRENT BODY MAGIC',b[:100]);print('HTML',b'html' in b[:300].lower())
out.append({'artifact':'sources/subgraph-centrality.pdf','status':'UNAVAILABLE_WRONG_HTML_LOGIN','rule':'No alternate delivery or retry. Search snippets remain unverified claim holds.'})
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'registry-and-access-assessment.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
